input.question: A bookstore marks up a $48 book by 25%, then runs a 20%-off sale on the new price. What is the sale price in dollars?
Pump A fills a 540-litre tank in 9 hours and pump B fills it in 18 hours. Working together from empty, how many hours do they take to fill it?
Mira buys 7 notebooks at $3.40 each and 3 pens at $1.85 each, and pays with a $50 bill. How much change does she get, in dollars?
A train leaves at 08:45 and travels 273 km at an average speed of 78 km/h. At what time does it arrive? Give the arrival time as the number of minutes after midnight.
A town's population was 18,400. It grew by 5% in the first year and shrank by 5% in the second year. What is the population after the second year?
A warehouse holds 14 pallets of 36 boxes each and 9 pallets of 52 boxes each. Then 117 boxes are shipped out. How many boxes remain?
Kofi cycles 18 km at 12 km/h, then rides the same 18 km back at 18 km/h. What is his average speed for the whole trip, in km/h?
Three friends split a $126 restaurant bill plus an 18% tip equally. How much does each person pay, in dollars?
What is the sum of all multiples of 7 between 100 and 200?
A phone costs $640 after a 20% discount. What was its original price, in dollars?
A printer prints 42 pages per minute. A second printer is 50% slower. Working together, how many minutes do they need to print 1,890 pages?
Lena saves $35 in week 1, and each week she saves $6 more than the week before. How much has she saved in total after 10 weeks, in dollars?
A rectangular garden measures 23 m by 17 m. A path 2 m wide runs around the outside of it. What is the area of the path, in square metres?
A recipe for 4 people uses 300 g of rice. Ines is cooking for 14 people, and rice is only sold in 500 g bags. How many bags must she buy?
A savings account pays 4% interest, compounded yearly. If $2,500 is deposited, how much is in the account after 2 years, in dollars?
Two cars start 390 km apart and drive toward each other at 70 km/h and 60 km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
